## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The rewrite of `requirement_proven` must be fixed before merge: an empty criteria list now counts as proven, which reverses the base behavior in a pull request described as having no behavior change. The remaining changed lines are mechanical typing, logging and sort-key replacements, subject to the limit under Not reviewed.

## Changes
The pull request replaces `typing.List`/`typing.Dict` with built-in generics and `log.warn` with `log.warning` in 180 `app/handlers/hNNN_records.py` files and in `app/handlers/h091_requirements.py`. It also switches `by_name` in `app/handlers/h040_sorting.py` to `operator.itemgetter`, rewrites the return expression of `requirement_proven`, and adds a one-line `review.txt` at the repository root.

## Critical
- app/handlers/h091_requirements.py:12 — correctness — Return False when the criteria list is empty — `requirement_proven([])` now returns `True` where the base returned `False`: the sum over no items is 0 and equals `len(criteria)`, while the removed `bool(criteria) and all(...)` short-circuited to `False`. Line 10 logs the warning and execution continues into the comparison. — Release review treats a requirement with no criteria as proven, contradicting the description's "No behavior change is intended." — Fix: Return `False` in the empty branch at line 10 or restore the `bool(criteria) and` guard, and extend `test_requirement_proof` in `tests/test_handlers.py` with the empty-list case.

## Not reviewed
- The 178 files `app/handlers/h002_records.py` through `app/handlers/h179_records.py` were not read in full; a pattern count over `../pr.diff` showed that every added or removed line in them has the form of the replacements read in `h000_records.py` and `h001_records.py`, without checking that handler and step numbers match between removed and added lines.
